fork_pipeline_execution_enabled.title: Fork Pipeline Execution Enabled
fork_pipeline_execution_enabled.description: Whether pipelines triggered from forked repositories are permitted to execute with the same privileges and secrets access as pipelines from the base/trusted repository.

branch_protection_pipeline_review_requir.title: Branch Protection Requires Pipeline Review Before Execution
branch_protection_pipeline_review_requir.description: Whether a human review/approval is required before pipeline definitions from unreviewed or external branches can be executed, preventing untrusted pipeline code from running automatically.

pipeline_definition_source.title: Pipeline Definition Source
pipeline_definition_source.description: Indicates where the pipeline definition file is sourced from when a pipeline executes — whether from the trusted base repository, a fork, or an unreviewed branch.

secrets_exposed_to_fork_pipelines.title: Secrets Exposed to Fork/Unreviewed Pipelines
secrets_exposed_to_fork_pipelines.description: Whether CI/CD secrets, tokens, or credentials are made available to pipelines originating from forked repositories or unreviewed branches.

privileged_mode_enabled.title: Privileged Container Mode Enabled
privileged_mode_enabled.description: Whether the pipeline runner executes jobs in privileged container mode, granting full host capabilities and device access.

host_namespace_access.title: Host Namespace Access Types
host_namespace_access.description: List of host namespaces the runner/job container has access to (e.g., hostNetwork, hostPID, hostIPC).

host_path_mounts.title: Host Path Filesystem Mounts
host_path_mounts.description: List of host filesystem paths mounted into the runner or job container (e.g., /, /var/run/docker.sock, /etc, /proc).

runner_run_as_root.title: Runner Executes Jobs as Root User
runner_run_as_root.description: Whether pipeline jobs run as the root user (UID 0) inside the container without user namespace remapping.

log_masking_enabled.title: Pipeline Log Masking Enabled
log_masking_enabled.description: Whether the CI/CD platform is configured to automatically redact or mask secret values injected as environment variables from build/job logs.

secrets_passed_as_plaintext_args.title: Secrets Passed as Plaintext Command-Line Arguments
secrets_passed_as_plaintext_args.description: Whether pipeline steps pass secret values directly as command-line arguments (e.g., --password=$SECRET) rather than via environment variables or mounted files, making them visible in process listings and logs.

pipeline_log_access_scope.title: Pipeline Log Access Scope
pipeline_log_access_scope.description: The breadth of access control applied to pipeline build logs — who can read them.

registry_precedence_enforced.title: Private Registry Precedence Enforced
registry_precedence_enforced.description: Indicates whether the build configuration explicitly enforces that private/internal registries are resolved before public registries, preventing public packages from shadowing internal ones.

dependency_hash_pinning_enabled.title: Dependency Hash Pinning Enabled
dependency_hash_pinning_enabled.description: Indicates whether all dependencies are pinned to specific cryptographic hashes (e.g., pip --require-hashes, npm package-lock.json with integrity fields, yarn.lock) preventing substitution with a different package at the same version.

public_registry_access_restricted.title: Public Registry Access Restricted
public_registry_access_restricted.description: Indicates whether build runner network policy or package manager configuration blocks direct access to public registries (e.g., pypi.org, registry.npmjs.org, Maven Central), forcing all resolution through a controlled private proxy or allowlist.

secret_scope.title: Secret Scope
secret_scope.description: The scope at which pipeline secrets/credentials are accessible — whether restricted to specific jobs/stages/protected branches or available globally across all pipelines and branches.

production_secrets_present.title: Production Secrets Present
production_secrets_present.description: Whether any of the pipeline secrets are production-grade credentials (e.g., cloud provider keys, database passwords, registry credentials, deployment tokens) rather than test/development-only values.

unprotected_branch_pipeline_trigger_allo.title: Unprotected Branch Pipeline Trigger Allowed
unprotected_branch_pipeline_trigger_allo.description: Whether pipelines can be triggered from unprotected or feature branches, allowing arbitrary code execution in a context that has access to the scoped secrets.

artifact_signing_enabled.title: Artifact Signing Enabled
artifact_signing_enabled.description: Whether cryptographic signing (e.g., Sigstore/cosign, GPG, Notary) is applied to build artifacts, container images, or binaries before promotion between pipeline stages.

artifact_hash_verification_enabled.title: Artifact Hash Verification Enabled
artifact_hash_verification_enabled.description: Whether cryptographic hash (checksum) verification is performed when artifacts are consumed in downstream pipeline stages or pulled from artifact storage before use.

static_token_lifetime_days.title: Static API Token Lifetime (Days)
static_token_lifetime_days.description: The maximum lifetime in days of static API tokens accepted by the pipeline orchestration API. A value of 0 indicates tokens never expire.

mfa_enforced_for_pipeline_triggers.title: MFA Enforced for Human Pipeline Trigger Accounts
mfa_enforced_for_pipeline_triggers.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is enforced for all human user accounts that can trigger or modify pipeline executions.

webhook_hmac_validation_enabled.title: Webhook HMAC Signature Validation Enabled
webhook_hmac_validation_enabled.description: Whether the pipeline orchestration API validates HMAC signatures on incoming webhook payloads before triggering pipeline runs.

unauthenticated_trigger_allowed.title: Unauthenticated Pipeline Trigger Permitted
unauthenticated_trigger_allowed.description: Whether the pipeline API exposes any endpoint that can trigger a pipeline run without any authentication credential (token, signature, or session).

token_rotation_enforced.title: Runner Registration Token Rotation Enforced
token_rotation_enforced.description: Indicates whether runner registration tokens are periodically rotated on a defined schedule or policy, preventing long-lived tokens from being exploited.

token_scope.title: Runner Registration Token Scope
token_scope.description: The scope to which runner registration tokens are bound — whether they are instance-wide (shared across all groups/projects), group-scoped, or project-scoped.

runner_registration_protected.title: Runner Registration Requires Additional Authorization
runner_registration_protected.description: Indicates whether runner registration requires additional authorization beyond the bare token (e.g., admin approval, IP allowlisting, or runner creation restricted to admins), preventing unauthorized runners from being registered with a stolen token.

cache_integrity_verification_enabled.title: Cache Integrity Verification Enabled
cache_integrity_verification_enabled.description: Indicates whether the pipeline verifies cryptographic checksums or signatures on restored cache artifacts before using them in the build.

cache_storage_access_control.title: Cache Storage Access Control Level
cache_storage_access_control.description: Describes the access control model applied to the shared cache storage backend (e.g., S3 bucket, GCS bucket, network share, local runner cache directory).

cache_scope.title: Cache Scope
cache_scope.description: Defines the sharing scope of the build cache — whether it is shared across all branches/pipelines, limited to a single branch, or isolated per pipeline run.

runner_network_isolation_enforced.title: Runner Network Isolation Enforced
runner_network_isolation_enforced.description: Whether pipeline runner nodes are restricted to build-time network resources only and blocked from accessing production infrastructure, secrets managers, and cloud metadata services.

metadata_service_access_blocked.title: Cloud Metadata Service Access Blocked
metadata_service_access_blocked.description: Whether access to cloud instance metadata services (e.g., 169.254.169.254, fd00:ec2::254) is explicitly blocked for runner nodes, preventing credential theft via SSRF or compromised build steps.

secrets_manager_reachable_from_runner.title: Secrets Manager Reachable from Runner
secrets_manager_reachable_from_runner.description: Whether runner nodes can establish network connections to internal or cloud secrets management services outside of explicit, audited pipeline-injected credentials.

audit_log_forwarding_enabled.title: Pipeline Audit Log Forwarding Enabled
audit_log_forwarding_enabled.description: Whether pipeline execution events (job triggers, secret access, artifact promotions, runner registrations) are forwarded to a centralized audit log system.

audit_log_immutability_enforced.title: Audit Log Immutability Enforced
audit_log_immutability_enforced.description: Whether the centralized audit log destination is configured to be immutable or write-once, preventing tampering or deletion of pipeline audit records.

audited_event_types.title: Audited Pipeline Event Types
audited_event_types.description: List of pipeline event categories currently captured in audit logs. Expected coverage includes job_trigger, secret_access, artifact_promotion, runner_registration, and deployment_trigger.

production_approval_required.title: Production Deployment Approval Required
production_approval_required.description: Whether the production environment has mandatory human approval gates configured before deployment (e.g., environment protection rules, manual approval steps, required reviewers).

direct_production_deploy_allowed.title: Direct Production Deployment Allowed Without Gate
direct_production_deploy_allowed.description: Whether a pipeline job can deploy directly to production without any intermediate approval, review, or environment protection enforcement.

approval_bypass_roles_count.title: Number of Roles/Identities Able to Bypass Approval
approval_bypass_roles_count.description: The count of distinct roles, service accounts, or user identities that can override or bypass the production approval gate (e.g., admin override, force-push privileges, bypass lists on protected environments).

version_has_known_cve.title: Current Orchestrator Version Has Known CVE
version_has_known_cve.description: Indicates whether the installed orchestrator version has one or more publicly disclosed CVEs in the NVD or vendor security advisories.

days_since_last_patch.title: Days Since Last Orchestrator Patch
days_since_last_patch.description: Number of days elapsed since the CI/CD orchestration platform was last updated or patched to a newer version.

patching_cadence_policy_defined.title: Patching Cadence Policy Defined
patching_cadence_policy_defined.description: Indicates whether a documented, enforced patching schedule exists for CI/CD orchestration components with a defined maximum patch interval.

egress_network_policy_enforced.title: Egress Network Policy Enforced
egress_network_policy_enforced.description: Whether an explicit egress allowlist or network policy restricts outbound traffic from runner nodes during job execution (e.g., firewall rules, Kubernetes NetworkPolicy, cloud security group egress rules).

egress_traffic_monitoring_enabled.title: Egress Traffic Monitoring Enabled
egress_traffic_monitoring_enabled.description: Whether outbound network traffic from runner nodes is logged and monitored (e.g., via a network monitoring tool, DNS query logging, flow logs, or a forward proxy with logging).

runner_network_isolation_mode.title: Runner Network Isolation Mode
runner_network_isolation_mode.description: The network isolation posture of runner nodes — whether they run in an isolated private subnet with controlled egress, a shared network with broad access, or fully air-gapped.

hardcoded_secret_patterns_detected.title: Hardcoded Secret Patterns Detected
hardcoded_secret_patterns_detected.description: Whether static analysis or regex scanning of pipeline definition files has identified patterns consistent with hardcoded credentials, API keys, tokens, or passwords.

secrets_manager_references_used.title: Secrets Manager References Used
secrets_manager_references_used.description: Whether credential values in the pipeline definition are supplied exclusively via secrets manager references (e.g., ${{ secrets.NAME }}, ${vault:...}, $CI_VARIABLE, parameter store lookups) rather than literal values.

image_reference_uses_digest.title: Base Image Reference Uses Immutable Digest
image_reference_uses_digest.description: Indicates whether all base image references in the pipeline job definitions use immutable SHA256 digest pinning (e.g., image@sha256:...) rather than mutable tags such as 'latest' or version strings.

mutable_tag_patterns_found.title: Mutable Tag Patterns Found in Image References
mutable_tag_patterns_found.description: List of mutable tag strings found in base image references across pipeline job definitions (e.g., 'latest', 'stable', 'main', 'edge', or bare version tags without digest). An empty array indicates no mutable tags were detected.

ephemeral_runners_enforced.title: Ephemeral Runners Enforced
ephemeral_runners_enforced.description: Whether the runner configuration enforces ephemeral (single-use) execution environments that are destroyed after each job completes, preventing environment reuse across jobs.

workspace_cleanup_enabled.title: Workspace Cleanup Between Jobs
workspace_cleanup_enabled.description: Whether the runner or pipeline configuration explicitly cleans up the workspace (working directory, temporary files, environment variables) between sequential job executions on the same runner host.
